certification.name: Certified Advanced Windows Forensic Examiner
certification.description: Advanced Windows forensics certification with an open-book written test of 125 questions (up to eight hours, 80% to pass) and a practical exam on image files and Windows artifacts completed within 30 days. Recertification requires a proficiency exercise in the third year and 40 hours of continuing education.
certification.currency_note: External certification fee (certification only, training not included); external candidates must show 36 hours of relevant training; fee is waived for students of the matching IACIS course; 2026 registration closes December 15
